description: PBMOD combines ionosphere calculations across several spatial scales. It models plasma composition and density, the development of irregularities and resulting radio scintillation in the low-latitude ionosphere. The resource is documented by Boston College. The documented physical domain is Global Ionosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Reliability depends strongly on external drivers and the scale selected for the calculation. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
